CELL_F.note: the pack node after the 25 A blade F3, to the block pads
CELL_F.always_on_why: the pack node after this board's 25 A blade: a fuse is protection and not a switch, and what opens this node is the pack's own gauge two stages upstream

CELL+.note: the pack lead from the XT60 J_BATT pin 2 to the blade F3, at the pack's own 10.0 A typical and 18.0 A peak. Declared 20 September 2026: it had been declared as nothing at all, so no power rule had ever looked at it
CELL+.always_on_why: the pack node BEFORE this board's 25 A blade: nothing on this board can open it, which is the same reason CELL_F gives one line up

VIN_RAW.note: shore and vehicle entry after the filter choke, 10 A fuse. THIS BOARD'S SHARE is 0.5 of the rail's 2 percent (16 September 2026): the entry, the choke and the dock block are a short run on this strip and measure 0.16 percent, while board A carries the same 8 A from the dock across the power board to its front end and measures 0.86, so the 1.5 points go there

+3V3_E6.note: the sensor controller's own 3.3 V from U13: the RP2040, the sensors and the three sealed sensor headers. A logic rail at a third of an amp over long thin tracks is fine at 3 percent
+3V3_E6.always_on_why: U13 is a TLV75533 whose EN pin is tied to its own input, so this rail follows the 5 V the AP63205 makes and has no switch of its own

+5V_E6.note: the local 5 V buck U12: the 3.3 V regulator's input and the Geiger tube's high-voltage supply on its own header
+5V_E6.always_on_why: U12 is an AP63205 whose EN pin is tied to CELL_F, the pack node it runs from, so this rail follows the pack and has no switch of its own

DC_IN.basis: the vehicle and shore input: 9 to 36 V in normal use, the LM5069's over-voltage lockout off at 40 V, and the SMCJ40A clamping a transient at about 64.5 V at its peak pulse current. The parts on this line are 100 V ceramics for that reason

DC_F.basis: the vehicle and shore input: 9 to 36 V in normal use, the LM5069's over-voltage lockout off at 40 V, and the SMCJ40A clamping a transient at about 64.5 V at its peak pulse current. The parts on this line are 100 V ceramics for that reason

DC_P.basis: the vehicle and shore input: 9 to 36 V in normal use, the LM5069's over-voltage lockout off at 40 V, and the SMCJ40A clamping a transient at about 64.5 V at its peak pulse current. The parts on this line are 100 V ceramics for that reason

DC_HS.basis: the vehicle and shore input: 9 to 36 V in normal use, the LM5069's over-voltage lockout off at 40 V, and the SMCJ40A clamping a transient at about 64.5 V at its peak pulse current. The parts on this line are 100 V ceramics for that reason

GND_V.basis: the vehicle-side return. It joins the kit ground through the choke's second winding and is NOT an isolation barrier, which is what boards/e.json declares to the ground system gate; it is a reference, and it is declared so a part across it is judged

GND.basis: the board's reference, so a part between a live net and ground is judged against the live net rather than reported as sitting on an undeclared one

U3_VCAP.basis: LM74700-Q1 VCAP: the internal charge pump sits about 10 V above the anode DC_F

PV_IN.basis: a 36-cell 12 V class panel: about 22 V open circuit at 25 degC and about 25 V cold. See the note in gen_sch_e.py about the 35 V bulk capacitors behind a 33 V clamp

PV_P.basis: a 36-cell 12 V class panel: about 22 V open circuit at 25 degC and about 25 V cold. See the note in gen_sch_e.py about the 35 V bulk capacitors behind a 33 V clamp

TRK_OUT.basis: the tracker's regulated output, set by R10 and R11 (115k over 10.0k)

TRK_SW1.basis: LT8705A buck-side switching node: it reaches the panel

TRK_SW2.basis: LT8705A boost-side switching node: it reaches the regulated output

TRK_INTVCC.basis: the LT8705A's own INTVCC regulator, which supplies both gate drivers

TRK_BOOST1.basis: the bootstrap rides on TRK_SW1 at INTVCC

TRK_BOOST2.basis: the bootstrap rides on TRK_SW2 at INTVCC

U4_VCAP.basis: LM74700-Q1 VCAP: the internal charge pump sits about 10 V above the anode TRK_OUT

E6_SW.basis: the AP63205's switching node: it swings to CELL_F, which is the pack at its 4S termination of 16.8 V, and a diode drop below ground on the other half of the cycle
